Remediation Action: Review privileged roles, remove unnecessary access and document approved exceptions.
Closure Evidence: Approved access review and updated role export
Validation Criteria: No unexplained privileged assignments; exceptions have owner and expiry.

Remediation Action: Enforce MFA for privileged accounts and verify coverage.
Validation Criteria: All in-scope privileged accounts covered or formally approved exception.

Remediation Action: Implement and validate network segmentation between defined trust zones.
Closure Evidence: Approved diagram, rule review and test results
Validation Criteria: Only approved network paths remain; exceptions are documented.

Remediation Action: Approve severity-based patch SLAs and escalate overdue vulnerabilities.
Closure Evidence: Approved SLA and remediation aging report
Validation Criteria: Critical/high findings are within SLA or have approved risk exceptions.

Remediation Action: Centralize critical logs and establish retention, alerting and review procedures.
Closure Evidence: Log-source coverage report and alert test
Validation Criteria: Critical sources onboarded; alert and retention tests pass.

Remediation Action: Execute a restoration test and compare results with approved RTO/RPO.
Closure Evidence: Restore test record and business-owner sign-off
Validation Criteria: Recovery results meet objectives or gaps have approved treatment.

Remediation Action: Complete risk-based security due diligence for critical vendors.
Validation Criteria: Critical vendors assessed; material gaps have owners and treatment.

Remediation Action: Introduce appropriate code review and automated security checks into CI/CD.
Validation Criteria: Checks run on in-scope repositories and bypasses are controlled.

Remediation Action: Move secrets to managed storage, rotate exposed credentials and enable scanning.
Closure Evidence: Secret scan report and rotation evidence without secret values
Validation Criteria: No active secrets in checked code; rotation and access controls validated.

Remediation Action: Run an incident-response tabletop exercise and track improvement actions.
Validation Criteria: Exercise objectives assessed and material actions assigned.

Remediation Action: Approve data classification and handling requirements with named owners.
Validation Criteria: Scope, handling requirements and exceptions are approved.

Remediation Action: Define cloud configuration baselines and monitor configuration drift.
Closure Evidence: Baseline, drift report and exception log
Validation Criteria: Critical drift detected, triaged and resolved or formally accepted.
